tagline: Elite top end, a robot bottom, and a win.
file: A star at running back and almost nothing else. Made his last real pick in round 6 and let the CPU draft the remaining seventeen rounds.
The silence. He promised to be positive and kind through the whole draft and has been quiet since Week 2.
YesChef23, who needles him in the restaurant arc, and the bench points that decide his close losses.
C33DeezNutzz in Week 6, and whether Gibbs gets a second scorer.

2026.headline: The first win, and the league has no winless team
story: Painty69 took Jahmyr Gibbs at 1.01, then McCaffrey and Barkley back to back, and then stopped. The last real pick was in round 6, and the CPU made the remaining seventeen, tying him with Johnny4Skins at eighteen autopicks.

Week 5 was the first win. He beat Hades9mm 153.1 to 126.24 with Jahmyr Gibbs at 37.7, the best RB of the week, and left 21.14 on the bench. The earlier losses were by 12.7, 32.3, 4.7 and 1.34. He is 1-4, 11th in the standings, with 650.24 points, sixth in the league.

He did not say a word in the Week 5 chat. Darkspaces and StealingGas used his name for a joke and he did not answer. The silence is the character. He holds the 1.09 on MAXPF, and a top-end roster with a robot bottom can still win.
takes: Gibbs did the job. The robot did not ruin it.
Positive and kind, and still silent.
